method.views: S=loose-shape-hash equal OR (>=12 insns, size ratio>=0.85, mnemonic cosine>=0.95); C=callee-set Jaccard>=0.5 (both nonempty); D=lbl-data-object-set Jaccard>=0.5 (both nonempty); X=full-body identical incl. numbers and <=16 insns. Edge iff S and (C or D or X). Families = connected components.

scopeA.definition: closure = the step3 getter callers (Tennis-unit functions with a tracked call to a controller getter or inline manager->array->controller load) PLUS Tennis-candidate callees receiving a controller-tainted value in r3-r10 at a direct bl (one level, same linear tracker as step3, getters excluded). upper = all Tennis-candidate direct callees of the getter callers.
